about: Expectations that legitimately DIFFER with the market clock, per pinned instant (testing/clock.js: post | rth). An intent listed here asserts these instead of its own `expect` at that instant (its own `expect` is the after-hours truth, unchanged). Locked by tests/test_uct_agent_capreg_baseline.py like every other entry.

rth.why: utils/extSession.js + capabilities/chart.js chart.setSession: on a DAILY chart "Include pre/post-market" is only available during pre- and post-market (the chart's own toggle is disabled in the regular session), so the request is refused and nothing changes
